crossRefs.note: Their duty shall be the ark, the table, the lamp stand, the altars, the vessels of the sanctuary with which they…
“This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting, regarding the most holy things.
When they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah reached for God’s ark, and took hold of it; for the cattle…
When those who bore Yahweh’s ark had gone six paces, he sacrificed an ox and a fattened calf.
David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up Yahweh’s ark to its place, which he had prepared for it.
For because you didn’t carry it at first, Yahweh our God broke out in anger against us, because we didn’t seek him…
Also the Levites will no longer need to carry the tabernacle and all its vessels for its service.”

people.name: Kohath
people.line: Son of Levi; Levite clan ancestor

translations.web: But to the sons of Kohath he gave none, because the service of the sanctuary belonged to them; they carried it on their shoulders.
translations.bsb: But he did not give any to the Kohathites, since they were to carry on their shoulders the holy objects for which they were responsible.
translations.kjv: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none: because the service of the sanctuary belonging unto them was that they should bear upon their shoulders.
translations.asv: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none, because the service of the sanctuary belonged unto them; they bare it upon their shoulders.
